label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for External Configuration Import at exact World interface world_external_import. The interface only inspects one explicitly configured source root and emits immutable external_import.candidate artifacts plus one external_import.receipt artifact. A candidate is not installed, available in any project, connected to any task, enabled, or live. The interface never writes the source, Active Registry, EE policy, run JSON, bindings, worker templates, worker-environment kinds, or private auth stores. It never copies credentials, access tokens, API keys, passwords, OAuth state, cookies, or static authorization values. Secret-bearing inputs yield redacted refused receipts with names or handles only. Instructions, skills, commands, memory, and imported history remain artifact candidates with source provenance. Remote MCP-like capability becomes an exact interface/Application candidate; local command-backed capability becomes a worker-environment-kind/Driver candidate. A saved user-facing Agent becomes a named worker-template candidate, never a runtime agent. Imported session or thread material becomes a history artifact candidate and never creates a run, conversation lane, session id, transcript inheritance, or task. Hooks remain explicit interface-behavior candidates. Unknown or unsupported fields are preserved as explicit unsupported receipts rather than guessed or silently dropped. Installation, project policy admission, task bindings, artifact bindings, worker-template authoring, Driver setup, and any later effect require separate authorized work over the ordinary Octopus primitives and separate evidence.
